environment_note: Project builds, tests and agent subprocess work paused during measurement. Other desktop applications remained active; warm filesystem caches, no CPU or memory isolation.

method.unit: whole CLI invocation including capability probe and worker process startup
method.pair_order: structure/hotspots then hotspots/structure on alternating rounds
method.cache: warm; committed blobs staged and hashed before warmups; no cache eviction
method.rss: Operating-system /usr/bin/time maximum resident-set statistic for the wrapped invocation. Not a simultaneous sum of core and worker RSS, not a cgroup/process-tree memory budget.
method.scope: Bounded source subsets and authored fixtures, not full-repository performance or a universal speedup.

provenance.selection: Tracked regular blobs with requested suffix, non-dot paths and 1..1048576 bytes; spread over sorted paths plus two largest remaining inputs; selected blobs must be UTF-8 without NUL. Read committed Git blobs, not the working tree. Attributes explicitly include generated/vendor selections.
